rationale: Dataset reconnaissance requires comprehensive assessment of five input tables. Plan unchanged in structure but caveats updated: (1) load_tables to establish row and column counts; (2) schema_summary to produce data_contract.json documenting all column types; (3) missingness with all_columns scope to expose every null pattern; (4) duplicate_check on all candidate keys to verify claim_id, rx_claim_id, provider_npi uniqueness; (5) date_ranges with consistency_checks to catch temporal anomalies; (6) join_check on all declared foreign keys to confirm referential integrity; (7) write_report now includes both synthetic_data and sample_preview caveats to clarify that the dataset is synthetic and that value samples are previews, not production findings.
changes_summary: Updated write_report caveats parameter from empty list to ['synthetic_data', 'sample_preview']. This addresses feedback T1-caveat_synthetic (data is synthetic, not production) and T1-caveat_sample_preview (shown values are previews). All other components remain unchanged.
